quests.name: Journey to Stonetalon Peak
quests.summary: Travel to Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak.

quests.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
quests.summary: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Find Teronis in Ashenvale.

quests.name: The Zoram Strand
quests.summary: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.

quests.name: Trek to Ashenvale
quests.summary: Find Raene Wolfrunner in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Warsong Runner Update
quests.summary: So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, <name>. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.

quests.name: Bathran's Hair
quests.summary: Bring 5 Bathran's Hair to Orendil Broadleaf in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Orendil's Cure
quests.summary: Bring Orendil's Cure to Pelturas Whitemoon in Astranaar.

quests.name: The Ancient Statuette
quests.summary: Bring the Ancient Statuette to Talen, in his camp near the Zoram Strand.

quests.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
quests.summary: There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might.  In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself.  The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down.  If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.

quests.name: On Guard in Stonetalon
quests.summary: Find Kaela Shadowspear overlooking the valley entering Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: On Guard in Stonetalon
quests.summary: Speak to Gaxim.

quests.name: Pridewings of Stonetalon
quests.summary: Bring 12 Pridewing Venom Sacs to Shindrell Swiftfire in Astranaar.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Find the Glowing Gem and return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar with Teronis' Journal.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Find Shael'dryn at the moonwell to the northeast.

quests.name: Warsong Scout Update
quests.summary: Keep an eye out, <race>. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?

quests.name: Elune's Tear
quests.summary: Bring Elune's Tear to Pelturas in Astranaar.

quests.name: The Ruins of Stardust
quests.summary: Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.

quests.name: Vorsha the Lasher
quests.summary: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

quests.name: An Aggressive Defense
quests.summary: Kill 1 Den Watcher, 2 Ursas, 10 Totemics, and 12 Warriors of the Foulweald tribe, and then return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

quests.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
quests.summary: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

quests.name: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur
quests.summary: Take down 12 Thistlefur Avengers and 12 Thistlefur Shaman; most are located east of Zoram Strand in Thistlefur Village.  Once completed, return to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Elemental Bracers
quests.summary: Collect 5 Intact Elemental Bracers and use the Divining Scroll on them. Afterwards, bring the Divined Scroll to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at the Silverwind Refuge.

quests.name: Freedom to Ruul
quests.summary: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Spintertree Post.

quests.name: Supplies to Auberdine
quests.summary: Speak with Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post after seeing Feero safely through Ashenvale Forest.

quests.name: Torek's Assault
quests.summary: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

quests.name: Troll Charm
quests.summary: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

quests.name: Ursangous's Paw
quests.summary: Bring Ursangous's Paw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Culling the Threat
quests.summary: Bring Dal Bloodclaw's Skull to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

quests.name: Mage Summoner
quests.summary: Slay Sarilus Foulborne and bring his head to Sentinel Velene Starstrike in Silverwind Refuge.

quests.name: Ruuzel
quests.summary: Bring the Ring of Zoram to Talen near the Zoram Strand.

quests.name: Stonetalon Standstill
quests.summary: Dispatch 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.Scout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost.Return to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Warsong Outrider Update
quests.summary: Much danger lies along this path, <name>. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near.We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale.  I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, <name>.

quests.name: Gleaming Crescent Necklace
quests.summary: Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.

quests.name: King of the Foulweald
quests.summary: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound.  Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner.  Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

quests.name: Satyr Horns
quests.summary: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

quests.name: Amongst the Ruins
quests.summary: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Je'neu of the Earthen Ring
quests.summary: Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Find the Wooden Key and a piece of Dartol's Rod before returning to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.

quests.name: Shadumbra's Head
quests.summary: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

quests.name: The Befouled Element
quests.summary: Bring the Befouled Water Globe to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Warsong Saw Blades
quests.summary: Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here...But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?

quests.name: Warsong Supplies
quests.summary: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Find the final piece of Dartol's Rod and return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Find the hidden shrine and re-enchant Dartol's Rod.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Find an uncorrupted furbolg, and using the power of Dartol's Rod of Transformation, speak to him.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Return to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.

quests.name: Forsaken Diseases
quests.summary: Bring a Bottle of Disease to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.

quests.name: Kayneth Stillwind
quests.summary: Take Shindrell's Note to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.

quests.name: Answered Questions
quests.summary: Return to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.

quests.name: Baron Aquanis
quests.summary: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Baron Aquanis
quests.summary: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Fallen Sky Lake
quests.summary: Retrieve a Fallen Moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle, then bring it to Pelturas in Astranaar.

quests.name: Passage to Booty Bay
quests.summary: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Kill 4 Bloodtooth Guards and retrieve Ran Bloodtooth's Skull for Krolg near Lake Mystral.

quests.name: Raene's Cleansing
quests.summary: Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

quests.name: Shared Fury
quests.summary:
Kill 5 Xavian Rogues, 5 Felsworn, 5 Betrayers, and 5 Hellcallers.
Return to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.

quests.name: Sharptalon's Claw
quests.summary: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

quests.name: The Barrens Port
quests.summary: Speak with Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

quests.name: The Caravan Road
quests.summary: Speak with Clerk Daltry in Darkshire.

quests.name: The Carevin Family
quests.summary: Speak with Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.

quests.name: The Howling Vale
quests.summary: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at the Shrine of Aessina.

quests.name: The Hunt Completed
quests.summary: <name>, you have slain all three beasts that comprise the Ashenvale Hunt.  You have brought me adequate proof of their demise; there is no question of your strength and tenacity.  The blood of a hunter streaks through your veins, and you should be commended!Please, accept this bauble as a sign of congratulations on your mighty deeds done in Ashenvale for the Horde today.  May your ancestors watch over you!

quests.name: The Lost Pages
quests.summary: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

quests.name: The Scythe of Elune
quests.summary: Look for signs of the Scythe of Elune then return to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.

quests.name: Velinde Starsong
quests.summary: Speak with Thyn'tel Bladeweaver at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

quests.name: Velinde's Effects
quests.summary: Search through Velinde's chest for her journal, then return it along with the key to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.

quests.name: Vengeful Trail
quests.summary: Maseara Autumnmoon wants you to search west of Forest Song, amongst the Satyrnaar demons. Report any signs of her husband Kurothel upon your return.

quests.name: Insane Druids
quests.summary: Kill the druids: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, Mavoris Cloudsbreak; then return to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.

quests.name: Satyr Slaying!
quests.summary: Bring 16 Satyr Horns to Illiyana in the Shrine of Aessina.

quests.name: Slowing the Orc Advance
quests.summary: Bring 6 Jagged Orc Swords and 4 Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.

quests.name: The Branch of Cenarius
quests.summary: Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at the Shrine of Aessina.

quests.name: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!
quests.summary: Find Anilia in Xavian.

quests.name: Outrider Basic Care Package
quests.summary: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, <name>.  As a reward, please take this care package!  Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.As you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase.  Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.
